usedFor: Microsoft Dynamics CRM is the source, with records like “New Opportunity”, and HubSpot receives them as deals through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An opportunity is the record closest to a deal, so sales sees it in HubSpot.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs an existing deal's ID, so a “New Opportunity” with no deal belongs in “Create Deal”.
